first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making a guarded onboarding simplification test the most direct response and more sustainable than matching competitor pricing. Verify the archived onboarding result before committing, while monitoring lead quality and downstream meaningful usage so faster completion does not reduce qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment with the shortened onboarding flow, using the confirmed evidence of +13% completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and +3% 30-day retention. This directly addresses both current declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Monitor activation quality, meaningful first actions, conversion, and downstream retention to ensure higher completion does not dilute account quality.
